title: JOIDES Resolution 科學鑽探船
summary: 以JOIDES Resolution科研史與岩芯資料為案例，從航次日誌到樣本分樣建立可重現分析鏈；將名義進尺與真正回收樣本長度區分。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use JOIDES Resolution history and core records to build a reproducible chain from expedition log to subsamples, distinguishing nominal penetration from recovered material. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 把測站研究時間與移航分開：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate station-science and transit time: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 把測站研究時間與移航分開 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate station-science and transit time and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把測站研究時間與移航分開：航段時間由距離除平均對地速度；調查、等待、轉彎與海況餘裕需分開。 本步以「航段時間與測站排程」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate station-science and transit time: Transit time is distance over mean ground speed; science stations, waiting, turns and weather allowance are separate. Use Transit time and station scheduling to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是JOIDES Resolution 科學鑽探船實際規格：距離D=63.6 km、平均對地速度12 km/h。式 t=D/v，基準結果 5.3 h。條件：單段定平均速度，不提供實際航海路線或避碰建議。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of JOIDES Resolution scientific drillship: Distance D=63.6 km, mean ground speed 12 km/h. Formula t=D/v gives 5.3 h. Conditions: Single leg at constant mean speed; no actual navigation route or collision-avoidance advice.
steps.failure: 用最大航速規劃所有航段會低估任務時間；應使用具來源的平均情境。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Planning every leg at maximum speed understates mission time; use a documented mean scenario. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將移航與測站工作畫成甘特時間條，避免把工作時間又計入航段平均速度。 本案例另須檢查「把測站研究時間與移航分開」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Draw transit and station work on a timeline and avoid counting station time again in transit speed. Also check that Separate station-science and transit time and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：把測站研究時間與移航分開。在岩芯標籤、樣本分樣圖、合成量測與航次日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加距離10%，保持平均速度，重算移航時間並保留工作時段。 算式區的基準值為5.3，改變後為5.83 h。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate station-science and transit time. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Core labels, subsampling chart, synthetic measurements and expedition log. Increase distance alone by 10%, retain mean speed and preserve station-work intervals. Baseline 5.3 changes to 5.83 h. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「JOIDES Resolution 科學鑽探船」的「把測站研究時間與移航分開：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Separate station-science and transit time: Mechanism and observation” in “JOIDES Resolution scientific drillship”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inspect vessel-motion effects on depth logs and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 檢查深度記錄的船動影響：作業端相對目標的垂向運動是船體升沉與補償位移的差；相位延遲可能放大殘差。 本步以「升沉補償的相對運動」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect vessel-motion effects on depth logs: Vertical motion relative to a target is vessel heave minus compensator travel; phase delay can amplify residual motion. Use Relative motion in heave compensation to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是JOIDES Resolution 科學鑽探船實際規格：同相船體升沉幅A=1.06 m、補償幅B=0.7 m。式 Ares=|A−B|，基準結果 0.36 m。條件：同頻同相的一維簡化，非實際控制器設定或海況限制。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. steps.failure: 只看各訊號幅度相同會忽略反相放大；要同時檢查相位與延遲。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Equal signal amplitudes can conceal anti-phase amplification; inspect phase and latency as well. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將兩條合成正弦曲線對齊時間戳後相減，再把補償訊號延遲比較殘差。 本案例另須檢查「檢查深度記錄的船動影響」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Align timestamps of two synthetic sine traces and subtract them, then delay compensation to compare residuals. Also check that Inspect vessel-motion effects on depth logs and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：檢查深度記錄的船動影響。在岩芯標籤、樣本分樣圖、合成量測與航次日誌完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加船體幅度10%，保持同相補償不變，觀察殘差增幅。 算式區的基準值為0.36，改變後為0.466 m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Inspect vessel-motion effects on depth logs. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Core labels, subsampling chart, synthetic measurements and expedition log. Increase heave amplitude alone by 10% at fixed in-phase compensation and observe residual growth. Baseline 0.36 changes to 0.466 m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
